Name: More Conversation Topics
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
[b][u][size=5]What This Mod Does:[/size][/u][/b]
This mod is a helper mod for dialogue mods. It adds a variety of new conversation topics to the game, which can be targeted by dialogue mods. It also allows other mods to define repeatable conversation topics. [b]This mod does nothing without content packs that rely on it.[/b]

[b][u][size=5]How to Use This Mod:[/size][/u][/b]
The config file contains a variety of config options, most of whose default is 7. These control how long (in days) the NPCs may talk about each of the related conversation topics. See [url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/MoreConversationTopics#configuration]the readme on Github[/url] for more details﻿. 

Multiplayer is untested at the moment, but I believe it should work. 

[b][u][size=5]For Mod Creators: [/size][/u][/b]
[url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/MoreConversationTopics#readme]See the readme on Github here[/url] for details.

This mod uses Harmony. The source code can be found [url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/MoreConversationTopics]at this Github link[/url]. The release notes can be found [url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/MoreConversationTopics/blob/main/docs/ReleaseNotes.md]at this Github link[/url].

[b][u][size=5]Thanks:[/size][/u][/b]
I would like to thank [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844?tab=user+files]Lumina[/url] for the idea, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6976914?tab=user+files]sophie[/url] for an incredible amount of code help and snippets, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/116553368?tab=user+files]atravita[/url] for pointing out bugs and adding GMCM support, and the Stardew Valley Discord #making-mods channel for support and help.
